<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1343
Claimant:
Susan Ellis
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
February 27, 2025
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
April 6, 2025
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
April 14, 2025
Reviewed the police report and the photos from the scene. Both the officer and the independent witnesses describe
the collision as it was reported, and the claimant is confirmed as an occupant of the vehicle.
April 15, 2025
Inspected the vehicle. Most of the damage lines up with the described impact along the driver's side. A few older
scratches are present that may predate this loss, and I have noted them separately for the estimate.
April 28, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account that matches the claimant's description of the lane change. The
claimant has told the same account in every conversation so far.
May 25, 2025
Received medical documentation for a knee injury. The type of injury and the force of the crash are consistent with
each other. Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so I have requested the treatment
notes.
May 26, 2025
The claimant's records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no lasting
effects. The prior episode has been noted, and I am reviewing it alongside the current treatment.
June 22, 2025
Liability and vehicle damage are well supported by the evidence. The open items are the length of treatment and the
relationship to the prior strain, and both are awaiting reocrds from the treating provider.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
